heroHeadline: US-Nigeria Joint Strikes Kill ISIS Global #2 as School Abductions Spread to Oyo and Borno
heroSubtitle: AFRICOM-Nigeria operations kill 175 ISWAP fighters in three days including top ISIS commander; dual mass school abductions in Borno (42–82 students) and Oyo (46 seized, 1 teacher beheaded) trigger national outrage; EFCC arrests fugitive ex-minister Saleh Mamman after ₦33.8bn fraud conviction; CBN holds MPR at 26.5% as April inflation ticks up to 15.69%
footerNote: Data sourced from official Nigerian government records, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are contested and drawn from multiple independent sources.
